title: Bridging clinic and wildlife care with AI-powered pan-species computational pathology
summary: The first result-bearing preprint reports transfer of a human-lung pathology CNN to veterinary specimens and a canine melanoma prognostic association. The claim is limited to the tested species and small veterinary cohorts; the prostate subgroup trend was nonsignificant and this does not establish broad wildlife or clinical benefit. Full indexed Research Square v1 PDF, Methods/Results and Nature/PMC record checked. Version-of-record statement links the same study; preprint posted 2022-03-29, before journal version 2023-04-26. The study reports 14,570 expert annotations and prognostic analysis in 100 canine cases (melanoma n=88, prostate n=12).
